name: foreach_minimum_scalar_list_
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_foreach_minimum_.ScalarList(...) -> (). Applies foreach minimum between a Tensor list and a scalar list paired with the input list; it mutates every tensor in self and returns no value. The correctness suite covers contiguous and noncontiguous floating inputs, exact overload dispatch, list-output values or in-place storage preservation, and mismatched list lengths where applicable.
